name: VC Dimension of the SCVC/VC Separation Class
proof: On $\{x_2,z\}$, the four concepts give the traces $00,01,10,11$, so VC dimension is at least two. Every three-coordinate projection has at most four traces, whereas shattering a three-set requires eight; hence VC dimension is exactly two. This is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
